comment: Immutable build inputs for reproducible tollgate-wrt artifacts. Every byte-affecting external input is pinned here. Update intentionally (see docs/reproducible-builds.md); never point portal.commit at a floating ref.

go.comment: The toolchain that compiles the shipped binaries. SOURCE OF TRUTH: the official golang of the pinned OpenWrt SDK release's packages feed (see .openwrt_sdk.go_per_release) — the feed defines it, so our binaries are reproducible against the SDK's own toolchain; never a minor of our own choosing (#448). scripts/sdk-go-version.sh check enforces it against the live feeds; update re-derives it.

gonuts.comment: The wallet fork every Go module pins IDENTICALLY. tests/contract/check-gonuts-pin.py enumerates carriers by glob (never a hand list) and fails on any disagreement with this value; scripts/bump-gonuts.sh rewrites manifest and every carrier together. Before a release is cut, release-check verifies this is the fork's latest stable tag. Pseudo-version integration pins are for branches only and must not outlive their tag on main.

npm.comment: Bundled with node 22.17.0; verified at install time.

nodogsplash.comment: The captive-portal daemon the module gates the network THROUGH. A RUNTIME dependency, not a byte of ours: we ship no part of it, we ship a DEPENDS on it (packaging/Makefile) and the SDK/feed resolves which one that is. Until this pin existed nothing in the repo named the version, so a feed bump silently changed what we ship. SOURCE OF TRUTH: the OpenWrt feed branch of each era (openwrt/routing, branch openwrt-<series>), which is what the era's digest-pinned SDK compiles against and what a router installs from. tests/contract/check-nodogsplash-pin.py audits this block three ways (offline identity, live feed, resolved artifact) and REFUSES on mismatch; it never edits, because bumping the daemon is a decision with its own risk, not a refresh.

upstream.comment: The upstream release the feed recipe builds. Shared by both eras today; the per-era blocks below carry the feed's packaging release, which is where the eras actually differ.

apk.comment: The only FEATURE target (25.12/apk). PKG_VERSION/PKG_RELEASE of openwrt/routing@openwrt-25.12; the released 25.12.0 feed publishes nodogsplash-5.0.2-r2.apk. source_hash is the feed recipe's PKG_HASH — the tarball the SDK unpacks. downloads_arch is the arch whose released-feed index is read to prove the package is PUBLISHED (the version is arch-independent; x86_64 always exists).

ipk.comment: FROZEN compatibility lane (<=24.10/ipk, security and stop-ship fixes only). openwrt/routing@openwrt-24.10 has never taken -r2, so the released 24.10.8 feed publishes nodogsplash_5.0.2-r1_<arch>.ipk.

nodogsplash.era_divergence: The two eras DO resolve different packaging releases of the same upstream version: apk 5.0.2-r2, ipk 5.0.2-r1 (the -r2 bump landed on the 25.12 branch only). That is why this pin is per-era rather than one string: a single value would be a false equality, passing for one lane while naming a package the other lane does not publish. Any consumer that names a nodogsplash version with a -rN suffix must name one of these two, and tests/contract/check-nodogsplash-pin.py reports which era each carrier matched instead of collapsing them.
nodogsplash.rebuild: Bumping this pin is NOT the way to get a fix: scripts/* do not rewrite it. Raise the feed's PKG_RELEASE upstream, or carry a deliberate decision (changelog fragment + ADR) — the daemon's behaviour is what every gate, session and pre-auth allow-list in this repo was bench-verified against, so a version change is a re-verification event.

go_per_release._comment: Official Go toolchain of each OpenWrt release line, as shipped by that line's openwrt/packages feed (branch openwrt-<series>). scripts/sdk-go-version.sh check|update audits these against the live feed; the pinned .go.version must match the entry of the pinned .release's series. In-SDK Go builds on 23.05/24.10 additionally require the tree's language minimum (generated into packaging/build-contract.json, go.minimum — 1.26.0 today) to be <= these versions, so only 25.x qualifies.

apk.comment: The apk-native era (OpenWrt >= 25.12): the SDK emits .apk regardless of config. Primary release line: the .go.version pin and sdk-go-version.sh's released-feed audit track THIS era.

ipk.comment: The ipk/opkg era for the installed base (feed-less 24.10 systems — fork #93/#110 evidence). Digests are the point-release tags from hub.docker.com/openwrt/sdk. The SDK packages STAGED PREBUILT binaries (the manifest-pinned Go compiles on the host), so the era's older feed Go (1.23.x) never compiles our code — go_per_release keeps it audited for awareness.
